intent: A short heading that rises in by word or by line, for docs heroes and empty states. The full string is always in the DOM.
useWhen: a docs or marketing hero heading
an empty-state title that should arrive gently
doNotUseWhen: page titles in product UI — PageHeader
repeated headings in lists or tables

children.note: Plain text. With by="line", separate lines with \n.

replayKey.note: Change it to play the reveal again.

label.note: Accessible text when it should differ from children.

motion.enter: each unit opacity 0 → 1 and translateY space.2 (word) / space.3 (line) → 0, motion.duration300 ease-out
motion.stagger: 40ms per word, 80ms per line, derived from motion.duration100 until a stagger token exists
motion.reducedMotion: final text at once, no stagger, no rise

requirements: the full string is in a visually hidden span; the animated units are aria-hidden
no bounce, no scale, plays once

doNot: Do not use it for more than one heading per view
snippet: <TextReveal as="h1">Agents that ask before they act</TextReveal>
